text:
Noah (Partnerships): Heads-up  running a regional SI enablement next month focused on cloud marketplace publishing + private deploys. Need decisions on localized cert requirements and partner announcement cadence.
Esha (SI Program): Nice. Do we want a separate APAC cert track (language + time zone friendly) or a unified global exam window?
Tomas (Training Ops): Strong preference for APAC-friendly windows. Also recommend a short localized practical: marketplace listing + privacy checklist.
Rina (Marketplace): For APAC listings we require extra metadata (language tags, data residency checkbox). Will add a validation step to sandbox.
Noah (Partnerships): OK let's make a new playbook appendix: "APAC SI Localizations" with required metadata, translated strings, and a 48h partner asset review SLA.
HW-bot: Hardware partner (CloudForge) availability: 3x A30 reserved for APAC pilot 09:00-13:00 JST on workshop days.
Esha (SI Program): Action items: Esha -> publish roster and preferred exam windows; Tomas -> create localized VM snapshot + rubric; Rina -> add validation step to sandbox; Noah -> draft announcement timeline with partner.
Tomas (Training Ops): I'll include a small scoring rubric in the VM README and a sample failure scenario (canary rollback). Also adding proctor notes: 1 proctor per 6 SIs.
legal-bot: Reminder: APAC customers may require DPA local addenda. Legal needs partner contact to fast-track.
Noah (Partnerships): I'll get partner contacts. If legal delays, use "partner preview" wording for public announcements.
lms-bot: Template: APAC cohort consent + localized slides available at https://intranet.redwood/lms/apac-si-playbook-v1.0
Esha (SI Program): Small demo snippet for playbook to show co-brand upload (sandbox):
```bash
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood/marketplace/suppliers \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_KEY" \
  -F "name=CloudForge" \
  -F "region=apac" \
  -F "locale=ja" \
  -F "asset=@cloudforge-logo.png"
```
Rina (Marketplace): Will include a checklist for co-brand approval and a tip to avoid screenshots with PII.
Esha (SI Program): Rehearsal call Fri 8am PT (flex for APAC). Tomas, can you run the proctor walkthrough then?
Tomas (Training Ops): Yep. I'll post the invite and upload the VM snapshot by Thu EOD.
Noah (Partnerships): Closing loop: I'll post the announcement draft and partner timeline here tomorrow. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
